description:
Make `jit validate <id> --rule <rule>` compute the one report from the records the capture parsed and return its rule selection.

## Background

- `validate_rule` (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:1896-1907`) captures the validation image and calls `rule_validation_report` (`:1063-1137`), which parses issues and declarations again, assembles configuration twice and evaluates the rule with the issue as its sole firing subject. A missing, off, non-graph or non-matching rule becomes one error finding (`validation::graph::select_graph_rule`). An unloadable rule set propagates as an error (`declarations_from_image(image)?`, `:1078`).
- `rule_validation_report` also serves the rule-validation gate checker, which keeps calling it.
- Tests: `tests/cli_query_graph/scope_validation_tests.rs:307-434` (rule validation through the executor) and `tests/cli_item_validate/validate_cli_rule_tests.rs:750-849` (CLI output).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `validate_rule` returns the report's rule selection for the issue and rule, computed from one validation capture whose parsed records the report reads.
- [hard] REQ-02: A selection error reports the same error finding as before, and the CLI rule tests pass unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: A harness test with an unloadable rule set shows that the rule view reports the `rules-file` finding; it fails on today's code, which returns an error.
- [hard] REQ-04: The executor-level rule tests in `scope_validation_tests.rs` are reduced to wiring or removed where the selection tests own the property.

## Notes

- Behaviour change: with an unloadable rule set the rule view reports the `rules-file` finding where it returned a load error.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Single-rule validation selects from the report
